mapper.sql: select id, reservation_no, customer_id, flower_id, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, reservation_date, delivery_time, reservation_status, contact_person, contact_phone, delivery_address, qr_code_url, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from flower_reservation

select r.id, r.reservation_no, r.customer_id, r.flower_id, r.quantity, r.unit_price, r.total_amount, r.reservation_date, r.delivery_time, r.reservation_status, r.contact_person, r.contact_phone, r.delivery_address, r.qr_code_url, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, c.customer_name, f.flower_name, c.phone as customer_phone from flower_reservation r left join flower_customer c on r.customer_id = c.id left join flower_info f on r.flower_id = f.id
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(reservation_date) as date, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM flower_reservation WHERE reservation_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(reservation_date) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(reservation_date) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customer_count FROM flower_reservation WHERE reservation_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(reservation_date) ORDER BY date
